bullets_en: Water crisis: Hyderabad to face shortage of 40–50 MGD next summer; 3L connections at risk.
Telangana Rakshana Sena picks Akash Kolluru as MLC candidate.
Shivanand Koujalagi, former minister and former MP, no more.
Cyclone Arnab Triggers Political Storm In Andhra, Jagan Reddy Targets Chandrababu Naidu.
BJP's Abhay Patel Mocks Rahul Gandhi Over Congress' 4-0 Defeat in Karnataka MLC Polls.
bullets_ur: Pani ka bohran: Hyderabad ko agli garmiyon 40–50 MGD kami ka samna hoga; 3 lakh connections khatray mein.
Telangana Rakshana Sena ne Akash Kolluru ko MLC candidate namzad kar diya.
Sabiq wazir aur sabiq MP Shivanand Koujalagi inteqal kar gaye.
Andhra mein Cyclone Arnab se siyasi toofan, Jagan Reddy ka Chandrababu Naidu par nishana.
BJP ke Abhay Patel ka Karnataka MLC polls mein Congress ki 4-0 shikast par Rahul Gandhi par tanz.
